newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends firm, Brent hits intra-day high.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends firm, Brent hits intra-day high.

text.p: IPE Dec gas oil closed sharply higher on Wednesday while Brent crude oil hit an intra-day high in a late afternoon rally.
Dec gas oil closed $5.75 a tonne higher at $216.50 a tonne, just off the session high of $216.75.
Dec Brent was trading up 52 cents at $23.35 a barrel by 1737 GMT, having reached a high of $23.41 slightly earlier.
"There's no particular news," said one broker, "It's pushing up through resistance ahead of the expiry."
The Dec contract expires at the close of trade on Thursday.
Dec gas oil was aiming to fill the gap left on Tuesday when the Nov contract expired at $220 a tonne, dealers said.

The market's initial bearish reaction to a record delivery of 865,100 tonnes against the expired Nov contract appeared to have been overtaken by a sentiment that the strong delivery reflected good physical buying interest.
"It also got support from Brent this morning, and again from (NYMEX) heating oil this afternoon," said one dealer.
NYMEX heating oil was trading 1.9 cents a gallon up at 70.15 at 1744 GMT.
